answer: Make rewards vest slowly. Each key's payout sits in escrow for 30 epochs before it unlocks, like water held behind a dune instead of a free oasis. If graders later link that key to a cluster (shared funding, matching answer timing), its whole unvested pile is burned, not just the latest epoch. A sybil farm then has to keep every fake key alive for a month while carrying the full slash risk, so the summit of its payoff sits weeks away and one detection wipes out all of it.
